meta.title: Addiction, Substance Use & Recovery — Simulator Data
meta.description: 650+ data points on alcohol, drugs, tobacco, pornography, gaming, social media, gambling, and prescription drug addiction. All statistics with primary sources. For use in life simulator probability engines.
